q: 办公室的灯还亮___呢。
zh: 办公室的灯还亮着呢。
py: bàn gōng shì de dēng hái liàng zhe ne
en: The light in the office is still on.
why: 还…呢 describes a scene that is still the case, so the lit-up state needs 着. 了 would only report the moment the light came on.

q: 诊室的门一直开___，没有人关过。
zh: 诊室的门一直开着，没有人关过。
py: zhěn shì de mén yī zhí kāi zhe méi yǒu rén guān guò
en: The door of the consulting room has been open the whole time; nobody has closed it.
why: 一直 says the open state has lasted, so 开着. 开了 reports the change of opening and cannot take 一直.

q: 小王一直戴___口罩，因为他感冒了。
zh: 小王一直戴着口罩，因为他感冒了。
py: xiǎo wáng yī zhí dài zhe kǒu zhào yīn wèi tā gǎn mào le
en: Xiao Wang has kept a mask on all along because he has a cold.
why: 一直 plus a worn item means the state continues, so 戴着. 戴过 only says he has worn one at some time.

q: 她手里还拿___那份病历，站在窗边发呆。
zh: 她手里还拿着那份病历，站在窗边发呆。
py: tā shǒu lǐ hái ná zhe nà fèn bìng lì zhàn zài chuāng biān fā dāi
en: She is still holding the medical record in her hand, standing by the window in a daze.
why: 还 and the scene description show she keeps holding it, so 拿着. 拿到 means got hold of, which is a completed result.

q: 电脑一直开___，可是没有人用。
zh: 电脑一直开着，可是没有人用。
py: diàn nǎo yī zhí kāi zhe kě shì méi yǒu rén yòng
en: The computer has been left on all along, but nobody is using it.
why: 一直 plus a lasting condition needs 着. 开了 would report that it was switched on, which clashes with 一直.

q: 已经晚上十点了，经理办公室的灯还亮___，他好像还在加班。
zh: 已经晚上十点了，经理办公室的灯还亮着，他好像还在加班。
py: yǐ jīng wǎn shàng shí diǎn le jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì de dēng hái liàng zhe tā hǎo xiàng hái zài jiā bān
en: It is already ten at night and the light in the manager's office is still on; he seems to be working overtime.
why: 还 shows the light is still on, so the held state 亮着. 亮了 would mean it just came on.

q: 他发烧了，所以一直躺___，什么也不想做。
zh: 他发烧了，所以一直躺着，什么也不想做。
py: tā fā shāo le suǒ yǐ yī zhí tǎng zhe shén me yě bù xiǎng zuò
en: He has a fever, so he has stayed lying down and doesn't feel like doing anything.
why: 一直躺 describes a posture that stays put, so 躺着. 躺了 with 一直 does not work, and 躺在 would need a place right after it.

q: 窗户还开___，快去关上。
zh: 窗户还开着，快去关上。
py: chuāng hu hái kāi zhe kuài qù guān shàng
en: The window is still open, go and shut it.
why: 还 plus a window that needs shutting describes a standing state, so 开着. 开了 gives no 'still'.

q: 他一直皱___眉头，是不是哪里疼？
zh: 他一直皱着眉头，是不是哪里疼？
py: tā yī zhí zhòu zhe méi tóu shì bù shì nǎ lǐ téng
en: He keeps frowning; is something hurting somewhere?
why: 一直 pairs with a continuing expression, so 皱着眉头. 皱了 reports a single frown.

q: 会议室里很安静，大家都低头坐___。
zh: 会议室里很安静，大家都低头坐着。
py: huì yì shì lǐ hěn ān jìng dà jiā dōu dī tóu zuò zhe
en: The meeting room is quiet; everyone is sitting with their heads down.
why: The sentence paints a still scene, so 坐着. 坐了 would tell of the moment they sat down.

q: 妈妈___衣服，你等她一下。
zh: 妈妈在穿衣服，你等她一下。
py: mā ma zài chuān yī fu nǐ děng tā yī xià
en: Mum is getting dressed; wait for her a moment.
why: 等她一下 shows the action is happening now, so 在穿. 穿着 would say she is already wearing clothes.

q: 他___一件白大褂，站在门口。
zh: 他穿着一件白大褂，站在门口。
py: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn bái dà guà zhàn zài mén kǒu
en: He is wearing a white coat, standing at the door.
why: Standing at the door is a result state: he already has it on, so 穿着. 在穿 would mean he is busy putting it on.

q: 爸爸___门，你先别进去。
zh: 爸爸在开门，你先别进去。
py: bà ba zài kāi mén nǐ xiān bié jìn qù
en: Dad is opening the door; don't go in yet.
why: 别进去 shows the opening is still happening, so 在开. 开着 would say the door already stands open.

q: 门___，你可以直接进来。
zh: 门开着，你可以直接进来。
py: mén kāi zhe nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē jìn lái
en: The door is open, you can come straight in.
why: 'Is open' is a state, so 开着. 在开 means someone is busy opening it, which would make coming straight in impossible.

q: 医生___病人的眼睛，请不要说话。
zh: 医生在检查病人的眼睛，请不要说话。
py: yī shēng zài jiǎn chá bìng rén de yǎn jing qǐng bù yào shuō huà
en: The doctor is examining the patient's eyes; please don't talk.
why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在. 检查着 sounds unfinished and needs a second action to follow.

q: 他今天___一条蓝领带，看起来很精神。
zh: 他今天戴着一条蓝领带，看起来很精神。
py: tā jīn tiān dài zhe yī tiáo lán lǐng dài kàn qǐ lái hěn jīng shén
en: He is wearing a blue tie today and looks very sharp.
why: Looking sharp describes how he is dressed, so 戴着. 在戴 means he is putting it on right now.

q: 小李___药，你过一会儿再问他吧。
zh: 小李在吃药，你过一会儿再问他吧。
py: xiǎo lǐ zài chī yào nǐ guò yī huì r zài wèn tā ba
en: Xiao Li is taking his medicine; ask him again in a while.
why: He is busy doing it now, so 在吃. 吃着药 is not a plain 'is taking medicine' and would need another action after it.

q: 办公室的窗户___，所以今天特别冷。
zh: 办公室的窗户开着，所以今天特别冷。
py: bàn gōng shì de chuāng hu kāi zhe suǒ yǐ jīn tiān tè bié lěng
en: The office windows are open, so it's especially cold today.
why: The windows are left open, a state that explains the cold, so 开着. 在开 would mean someone is opening them right now.

q: 我走进诊室的时候，医生___口罩，所以我没认出他。
zh: 我走进诊室的时候，医生戴着口罩，所以我没认出他。
py: wǒ zǒu jìn zhěn shì de shí hou yī shēng dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ wǒ méi rèn chū tā
en: When I walked into the consulting room the doctor was wearing a mask, so I didn't recognize him.
why: I failed to recognize him because the mask was already on, which is a state, so 戴着. 在戴 would mean he was in the middle of putting it on.

q: 老师站___上课。
zh: 老师站着上课。
py: lǎo shī zhàn zhe shàng kè
en: The teacher teaches standing up.
why: 站 is the posture in which 上课 happens, so it takes 着. Without it the two verbs do not link.

q: 他躺___看手机，所以眼睛很累。
zh: 他躺着看手机，所以眼睛很累。
py: tā tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī suǒ yǐ yǎn jing hěn lèi
en: He lies down looking at his phone, so his eyes are tired.
why: 躺 is the background posture and carries 着; 看手机 is the main action. 在 cannot attach straight after a verb here.

q: 我喜欢听___音乐写报告。
zh: 我喜欢听着音乐写报告。
py: wǒ xǐ huan tīng zhe yīn yuè xiě bào gào
en: I like writing reports while listening to music.
why: 听音乐 is the accompanying action, so 听着. 听了 would be a finished event, which clashes with 喜欢.

q: 同事低___头走进办公室，什么也没说。
zh: 同事低着头走进办公室，什么也没说。
py: tóng shì dī zhe tóu zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì shén me yě méi shuō
en: My colleague walked into the office with his head down and said nothing.
why: The posture 低头 is held while walking in, so 低着头. 地 is the adverb marker and cannot follow a single verb like 低.

q: 孩子咳嗽___说：“我不想吃药。”
zh: 孩子咳嗽着说：“我不想吃药。”
py: hái zi ké sou zhe shuō wǒ bù xiǎng chī yào
en: The child said, coughing, 'I don't want to take medicine.'
why: The coughing goes on while speaking, so 咳嗽着说. 地 marks an adverb and does not fit after the verb 咳嗽.

q: 他靠___椅子，慢慢地向大家介绍了新计划。
zh: 他靠着椅子，慢慢地向大家介绍了新计划。
py: tā kào zhe yǐ zi màn màn de xiàng dà jiā jiè shào le xīn jì huà
en: Leaning back in his chair, he slowly introduced the new plan to everyone.
why: 靠 is his posture during the introduction, so 靠着. 地 is already used for 慢慢地 and cannot join 靠 to its object.

q: 护士扶___老人走进诊室，小声告诉医生他最近睡得不好。
zh: 护士扶着老人走进诊室，小声告诉医生他最近睡得不好。
py: hù shì fú zhe lǎo rén zǒu jìn zhěn shì xiǎo shēng gào sù yī shēng tā zuì jìn shuì de bù hǎo
en: The nurse helped the old man into the consulting room and quietly told the doctor he had been sleeping badly lately.
why: 扶 is the manner of 走进诊室, so 扶着. 扶过 would only say she had helped him before.

q: 桌子上放___一台电脑。
zh: 桌子上放着一台电脑。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī tái diàn nǎo
en: There is a computer on the desk.
why: Place + verb + 着 + thing describes what is sitting somewhere, so 放着. 放在 needs the place after it, not the thing.

q: 墙上挂___一张地图。
zh: 墙上挂着一张地图。
py: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī zhāng dì tú
en: There is a map hanging on the wall.
why: The place comes first and 着 follows the verb: 墙上挂着一张地图. 挂在 would need the place to follow.

q: 门口站___一个人。
zh: 门口站着一个人。
py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī gè rén
en: There is someone standing at the door.
why: A scene description with the place first takes 站着 + 一个人. 站在 would be followed by a place, not by 一个人.

q: 医院门口现在还停___两辆救护车。
zh: 医院门口现在还停着两辆救护车。
py: yī yuàn mén kǒu xiàn zài hái tíng zhe liǎng liàng jiù hù chē
en: Two ambulances are still parked at the hospital entrance.
why: 现在还 makes it a state that holds, so 停着. 停了 does not combine with 还 and would only report that they stopped.

q: 黑板上写___今天会议的时间和地点。
zh: 黑板上写着今天会议的时间和地点。
py: hēi bǎn shàng xiě zhe jīn tiān huì yì de shí jiān hé dì diǎn
en: The time and place of today's meeting are written on the blackboard.
why: Place + verb + 着 + thing is the pattern: 写着. 地 and 的 cannot take the verb slot here.

q: 办公桌后面坐___一位年轻的医生。
zh: 办公桌后面坐着一位年轻的医生。
py: bàn gōng zhuō hòu miàn zuò zhe yī wèi nián qīng de yī shēng
en: A young doctor is sitting behind the desk.
why: The place leads and 坐着 introduces who is sitting there. 坐在 is always followed by a place, not by a person.

q: 走廊两边贴___很多关于健康的海报，大家路过时都会看一眼。
zh: 走廊两边贴着很多关于健康的海报，大家路过时都会看一眼。
py: zǒu láng liǎng biān tiē zhe hěn duō guān yú jiàn kāng de hǎi bào dà jiā lù guò shí dōu huì kàn yī yǎn
en: Lots of health posters are stuck up on both sides of the corridor, and everyone takes a look as they pass.
why: The corridor is the place and 贴着 describes the posters that are up there. 的 and 地 are particles, not the verb slot.

q: 他的办公桌上堆___很多还没处理的文件，旁边还放着一杯凉了的茶。
zh: 他的办公桌上堆着很多还没处理的文件，旁边还放着一杯凉了的茶。
py: tā de bàn gōng zhuō shàng duī zhe hěn duō hái méi chǔ lǐ de wén jiàn páng biān hái fàng zhe yī bēi liáng le de chá
en: Piles of unprocessed documents are stacked on his desk, with a cup of cold tea beside them.
why: 堆着 says what is lying there. 堆到 would need a destination, and 堆在 would need a place after it.

q: 你拿___这杯水，我去开门。
zh: 你拿着这杯水，我去开门。
py: nǐ ná zhe zhè bēi shuǐ wǒ qù kāi mén
en: Hold this glass of water, I'll go and open the door.
why: An order to keep holding something uses verb + 着. 拿了 reports a finished act, and 在 cannot follow the verb.

q: 你坐___吧，我自己来。
zh: 你坐着吧，我自己来。
py: nǐ zuò zhe ba wǒ zì jǐ lái
en: Stay seated, I'll do it myself.
why: The speaker tells someone already sitting not to get up, which is 坐着吧. 坐了吧 does not exist as a command.

q: 你在这儿等___，我马上回来。
zh: 你在这儿等着，我马上回来。
py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ mǎ shàng huí lái
en: Wait here, I'll be right back.
why: 等着 means keep waiting until I'm back. 等了 would say that you waited, which is not an order.

q: 医生让我躺___，不要动。
zh: 医生让我躺着，不要动。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ tǎng zhe bù yào dòng
en: The doctor told me to stay lying down and not move.
why: The doctor wants the posture held, so 躺着. 躺了 would report that I lay down and gives no instruction to stay.

q: 你听___，这个问题非常重要，下午开会的时候一定要说。
zh: 你听着，这个问题非常重要，下午开会的时候一定要说。
py: nǐ tīng zhe zhè ge wèn tí fēi cháng zhòng yào xià wǔ kāi huì de shí hou yī dìng yào shuō
en: Listen, this issue is very important; you must raise it at the afternoon meeting.
why: 'Listen up' as a command is 你听着. 听到 means heard it, which is a result rather than an order.

q: 这份报告你先带___，明天开会的时候给经理。
zh: 这份报告你先带着，明天开会的时候给经理。
py: zhè fèn bào gào nǐ xiān dài zhe míng tiān kāi huì de shí hou gěi jīng lǐ
en: Keep this report with you for now and give it to the manager at tomorrow's meeting.
why: The report is to stay with you until tomorrow, so 带着. 带了 would say you brought it already.

q: 这是你的体检单，请你好好记___，下次检查的时候带来。
zh: 这是你的体检单，请你好好记着，下次检查的时候带来。
py: zhè shì nǐ de tǐ jiǎn dān qǐng nǐ hǎo hǎo jì zhe xià cì jiǎn chá de shí hou dài lái
en: This is your check-up form; please keep it in mind and bring it next time.
why: 记着 is the order to keep something in mind. 记了 only reports that you noted it down.

q: 你先在椅子上坐___，医生马上就来给你检查。
zh: 你先在椅子上坐着，医生马上就来给你检查。
py: nǐ xiān zài yǐ zi shàng zuò zhe yī shēng mǎ shàng jiù lái gěi nǐ jiǎn chá
en: Stay seated in the chair for now; the doctor will be right in to examine you.
why: The order is to remain seated until the doctor comes, so 坐着. 坐了 is a past report and cannot be an order.

q: 我今天___戴着口罩，所以有点儿感冒。
zh: 我今天没戴着口罩，所以有点儿感冒。
py: wǒ jīn tiān méi dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn r gǎn mào
en: I haven't been wearing a mask today, so I've caught a bit of a cold.
why: A 着 state is denied with 没. 不 is not used with 戴着, and 别 is only for commands.

q: 办公室的窗户___开着，是关着的。
zh: 办公室的窗户没开着，是关着的。
py: bàn gōng shì de chuāng hu méi kāi zhe shì guān zhe de
en: The office window isn't open; it's closed.
why: Denying a 着 state takes 没, never 不. 别 would turn it into an order.

q: 他___站着，一直坐在椅子上。
zh: 他没站着，一直坐在椅子上。
py: tā méi zhàn zhe yī zhí zuò zài yǐ zi shàng
en: He wasn't standing; he sat in the chair the whole time.
why: Denying a state that held (or did not) uses 没 + verb + 着. 不 + verb + 着 does not exist.

q: 你感冒了，___躺着看手机，快睡觉吧。
zh: 你感冒了，别躺着看手机，快睡觉吧。
py: nǐ gǎn mào le bié tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī kuài shuì jiào ba
en: You have a cold; don't lie there looking at your phone, go to sleep.
why: Telling someone to stop holding a posture is 别 + verb + 着. 没 and 不 describe facts, not orders.

q: 他的电脑___开着，所以我以为他不在办公室。
zh: 他的电脑没开着，所以我以为他不在办公室。
py: tā de diàn nǎo méi kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wǒ yǐ wéi tā bù zài bàn gōng shì
en: His computer wasn't on, so I thought he wasn't in the office.
why: A past or present 着 state is denied with 没. 不开着 is not Chinese and 别 would be a command.

q: 他___走进办公室，大家都笑了。
zh: 他唱着歌走进办公室，大家都笑了。
py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì dà jiā dōu xiào le
en: He walked into the office singing, and everyone laughed.
why: 着 sits right after the verb and before the object: 唱着歌. 着唱歌 and 歌唱着 put 着 in the wrong place.

q: 他___椅子上看报告。
zh: 他坐在椅子上看报告。
py: tā zuò zài yǐ zi shàng kàn bào gào
en: He sits in the chair reading a report.
why: With a place after the verb the form is 坐在 + place, with no 着. 坐着在 stacks 着 before 在.

q: 同事___女儿来公司，大家都很喜欢她。
zh: 同事带着女儿来公司，大家都很喜欢她。
py: tóng shì dài zhe nǚ ér lái gōng sī dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huan tā
en: A colleague brought her daughter to the company, and everyone likes her.
why: 着 attaches right after the verb: 带着女儿. 着带 and 带了着 put it in the wrong place.

q: 我知道___你今天不舒服。
zh: 我知道你今天不舒服。
py: wǒ zhī dào nǐ jīn tiān bù shū fu
en: I know you aren't feeling well today.
why: 知道 is already a state, so nothing can hold: no 着. Adding 了 or 过 changes it into getting to know or having known.

q: 他今天九点到___办公室，一直忙到现在。
zh: 他今天九点到了办公室，一直忙到现在。
py: tā jīn tiān jiǔ diǎn dào le bàn gōng shì yī zhí máng dào xiàn zài
en: He got to the office at nine today and has been busy ever since.
why: 到 is an instant arrival, so no 着; 了 marks the completed arrival. 到过 would mean he once visited, which clashes with staying busy since then.

q: 我们等___三个小时，医生才来。
zh: 我们等了三个小时，医生才来。
py: wǒ men děng le sān gè xiǎo shí yī shēng cái lái
en: We waited three hours before the doctor came.
why: A duration after the verb needs 了, never 着, because 着 cannot be measured.

q: 他觉得___这个办法不太好。
zh: 他觉得这个办法不太好。
py: tā jué de zhè ge bàn fǎ bù tài hǎo
en: He thinks this method is not very good.
why: 觉得 is a thinking verb with nothing to hold, so no 着 goes after it. 了 would change it into a different meaning.

q: 我在医院门口等___半个小时，可是他还没来。
zh: 我在医院门口等了半个小时，可是他还没来。
py: wǒ zài yī yuàn mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí kě shì tā hái méi lái
en: I waited half an hour at the hospital entrance, but he still hasn't come.
why: 半个小时 is a measured duration, so 等了半个小时. 等着 cannot be followed by a duration.

q: 他已经忘___把药带来了，真麻烦。
zh: 他已经忘了把药带来了，真麻烦。
py: tā yǐ jīng wàng le bǎ yào dài lái le zhēn má fan
en: He has already forgotten to bring the medicine; what a nuisance.
why: 忘 is an instant change, so it takes 了 and never 着.

q: 他们已经离开___公司，现在在去机场的路上。
zh: 他们已经离开了公司，现在在去机场的路上。
py: tā men yǐ jīng lí kāi le gōng sī xiàn zài zài qù jī chǎng de lù shàng
en: They have already left the company and are now on the way to the airport.
why: 离开 is an instant change, so it takes 了. 着 does not fit, and 过 would clash with the present on-the-way situation.

zh: 他穿着白大褂。
py: tā chuān zhe bái dà guà
en: He is wearing a white coat.
why: 穿着 keeps the verb and 着 together, followed by the thing worn. 着 cannot stand after 白大褂.

zh: 黑板旁边挂着一个时钟。
py: hēi bǎn páng biān guà zhe yī gè shí zhōng
en: There is a clock hanging beside the blackboard.
why: Place first, then verb + 着, then the new thing. 一个时钟 cannot lead the sentence in this pattern.

zh: 办公室门口停着一辆白色的车。
py: bàn gōng shì mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng bái sè de chē
en: A white car is parked at the office entrance.
why: Place + verb + 着 + thing. The place comes first and is not marked with 在.

zh: 经理站着开会。
py: jīng lǐ zhàn zhe kāi huì
en: The manager holds the meeting standing up.
why: 着 goes on the posture verb 站, which comes first. 开会 is the main verb and stays bare.

zh: 他喜欢躺着看手机。
py: tā xǐ huan tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī
en: He likes to look at his phone lying down.
why: 躺着 is the background posture and must precede 看手机. Reversing them would make looking the posture.

zh: 你拿着这个文件。
py: nǐ ná zhe zhè ge wén jiàn
en: Hold this document.
why: 拿着 is the command to keep holding. The object may be fronted as a topic, so both orders are right.

zh: 你在这儿等着我。
py: nǐ zài zhè r děng zhe wǒ
en: Wait here for me.
why: 等着 is the order to keep waiting. The place phrase can precede or follow 你.

zh: 他没戴着口罩。
py: tā méi dài zhe kǒu zhào
en: He isn't wearing a mask.
why: 没 comes before the verb + 着. 不 is never used to deny a 着 state.

zh: 别躺着看手机。
py: bié tǎng zhe kàn shǒu jī
en: Don't look at your phone lying down.
why: 别 comes first and 着 stays on the first verb 躺. 看手机 follows as the main action.

zh: 她带着孩子来上班了。
py: tā dài zhe hái zi lái shàng bān le
en: She came to work with her child.
why: 着 stays glued to 带, before the object 孩子. 了 closes the sentence after 上班.

zh: 医生在检查病人。
py: yī shēng zài jiǎn chá bìng rén
en: The doctor is examining the patient.
why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在 before the verb. 着 is not needed.

zh: 会议室的桌子上放着三杯咖啡。
py: huì yì shì de zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe sān bēi kā fēi
en: There are three cups of coffee on the meeting-room table.
why: Place first, then verb + 着, then number + measure + noun. 在 does not appear before the verb.

zh: 经理办公室的门一直开着。
py: jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì de mén yī zhí kāi zhe
en: The door to the manager's office has been open all along.
why: 一直 sits before the verb, and 着 follows 开. 开着 cannot precede 一直.

zh: 病人手里还拿着那张检查单。
py: bìng rén shǒu lǐ hái ná zhe nà zhāng jiǎn chá dān
en: The patient is still holding that examination form.
why: 还 comes before the verb, and 着 follows it directly. The object comes last.

zh: 她红着眼睛走出了医生办公室。
py: tā hóng zhe yǎn jing zǒu chū le yī shēng bàn gōng shì
en: She walked out of the doctor's office with red eyes.
why: 红着眼睛 is the state in which she walked out, so it precedes 走出了. 了 stays on the main verb.

task: Say he is wearing a coat (a state, not the act).
zh: 他穿着大衣。
py: tā chuān zhe dà yī
en: He is wearing a coat.
why: In the source 在穿 means he is putting the coat on. The state of wearing it is 穿着.

src_py: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn hēi wài tào
task: Say he is putting on a black coat right now.
zh: 他在穿一件黑外套。
py: tā zài chuān yī jiàn hēi wài tào
en: He is putting on a black coat.
why: The act in progress needs 在 before the verb, and 着 is dropped.

src_py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu yī bēi kā fēi
task: Say how it sits there: use 放.
zh: 桌子上放着一杯咖啡。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī bēi kā fēi
en: There is a cup of coffee on the table.
why: Place + 放着 + thing says that something is placed there. The place stays first.

src_py: yǒu yī wèi hù shì zhàn zài mén kǒu
task: Start with the place and use 着.
zh: 门口站着一位护士。
py: mén kǒu zhàn zhe yī wèi hù shì
en: A nurse is standing at the door.
why: Place leads, then 站着, then the new person. Put 着 on 站 and drop 在.

src: 她笑了，然后回答了我的问题。
src_py: tā xiào le rán hòu huí dá le wǒ de wèn tí
task: Make the smile the manner of answering.
zh: 她笑着回答了我的问题。
py: tā xiào zhe huí dá le wǒ de wèn tí
en: She answered my question with a smile.
why: 笑着 becomes the manner of the main verb 回答, which keeps 了.

src_py: hù shì dài zhe shǒu tào
zh: 护士没戴着手套。
py: hù shì méi dài zhe shǒu tào
en: The nurse isn't wearing gloves.
why: Add 没 before the verb and keep 着. 不 never negates a 着 state.

src_py: nǐ ná yī xià zhè bēi shuǐ
task: Say 'Hold this cup of water' with 着.
zh: 你拿着这杯水。
py: nǐ ná zhe zhè bēi shuǐ
en: Hold this cup of water.
why: 拿着 turns the request into keep holding it. The object may be fronted, so both orders work.

src_py: bìng rén zài chuáng shàng tǎng zhe
task: Turn it into an order: stay lying down.
zh: 你躺着吧。
py: nǐ tǎng zhe ba
en: Stay lying down.
why: 躺着吧 tells the patient to keep the posture. It drops the place and the third person.

src_py: tā chàng gē zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì
task: Say he walked in singing, using 着.
zh: 他唱着歌走进办公室。
py: tā chàng zhe gē zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì
en: He walked into the office singing.
why: 着 attaches to 唱 and splits it from 歌. 走进 stays the main verb.

src_py: hù shì zài yī yuàn mén kǒu děng nǐ
task: Say the nurse is waiting there with 着 and 在 the place.
zh: 护士在医院门口等着你。
py: hù shì zài yī yuàn mén kǒu děng zhe nǐ
en: The nurse is waiting for you at the hospital entrance.
why: On this reading the place stays before the verb and 着 follows 等. Do not put 着 after the place phrase.

s: 窗户一直开了，所以屋里很冷。
s_py: chuāng hu yì zhí kāi le suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
zh: 窗户一直开着，所以屋里很冷。
py: chuāng hu yī zhí kāi zhe suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
en: The window has been open all along, so it's cold in the room.
why: 一直 needs the lasting state 开着. 开了 reports the change of opening and cannot take 一直.

s: 医生今天一直忙着，没有时间吃午饭。
s_py: yī shēng jīn tiān yì zhí máng zhe méi yǒu shí jiān chī wǔ fàn
zh: 医生今天一直忙着，没有时间吃午饭。
py: yī shēng jīn tiān yī zhí máng zhe méi yǒu shí jiān chī wǔ fàn
en: The doctor has been busy all day and had no time to eat lunch.
why: 忙着 is correct: 着 can follow a state verb like 忙, and 一直 helps. The sentence is not wrong because 忙 is not a posture.

s: 经理办公室里亮着灯，他可能还没走。
s_py: jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì lǐ liàng zhe dēng tā kě néng hái méi zǒu
zh: 经理办公室里亮着灯，他可能还没走。
py: jīng lǐ bàn gōng shì lǐ liàng zhe dēng tā kě néng hái méi zǒu
en: The light is on in the manager's office; he may not have left yet.
why: The place comes first and 亮着 is a lit-up state. It looks like it might need 了 but a lasting scene takes 着.

s: 你看，门在开，我们可以进去了。
s_py: nǐ kān mén zài kāi wǒ men kě yǐ jìn qù le
zh: 你看，门开着，我们可以进去了。
py: nǐ kàn mén kāi zhe wǒ men kě yǐ jìn qù le
en: Look, the door is open, we can go in now.
why: 'Is open' is a state, so 开着. 在开 means someone is opening it right now, which would not let us go in.

s: 她今天在穿一条红裙子，真漂亮。
s_py: tā jīn tiān zài chuān yī tiáo hóng qún zi zhēn piào liàng
zh: 她今天穿着一条红裙子，真漂亮。
py: tā jīn tiān chuān zhe yī tiáo hóng qún zi zhēn piào liang
en: She is wearing a red skirt today; it looks lovely.
why: Admiring what she looks like needs the state 穿着. 在穿 is the act of putting it on.

s: 他在吃药，请你等一会儿再进去。
s_py: tā zài chī yào qǐng nǐ děng yī huì r zài jìn qù
zh: 他在吃药，请你等一会儿再进去。
py: tā zài chī yào qǐng nǐ děng yī huì r zài jìn qù
en: He is taking his medicine; please wait a little before going in.
why: An ordinary action in progress takes 在. 吃着药 would sound unfinished here.

s: 老板站开会，大家也不敢坐。
s_py: lǎo bǎn zhàn kāi huì dà jiā yě bù gǎn zuò
zh: 老板站着开会，大家也不敢坐。
py: lǎo bǎn zhàn zhe kāi huì dà jiā yě bù gǎn zuò
en: The boss holds the meeting standing up, and nobody dares to sit.
why: The posture 站 needs 着 to link to the main verb 开会. Without it the two verbs cannot join.

s: 护士笑回答了病人的问题。
s_py: hù shì xiào huí dá le bìng rén de wèn tí
zh: 护士笑着回答了病人的问题。
py: hù shì xiào zhe huí dá le bìng rén de wèn tí
en: The nurse answered the patient's question with a smile.
why: 笑 is the manner and must carry 着. 了 belongs to the main verb 回答.

s: 他们坐着聊了一个下午，什么事也没做。
s_py: tā men zuò zhe liáo le yí gè xià wǔ shén me shì yě méi zuò
zh: 他们坐着聊了一个下午，什么事也没做。
py: tā men zuò zhe liáo le yī gè xià wǔ shén me shì yě méi zuò
en: They sat and chatted all afternoon without doing anything.
why: 着 is on the posture verb 坐 and 了 plus the duration is on the main verb 聊. Both are in the right place.

s: 桌子上在放着一份报告。
s_py: zhuō zi shàng zài fàng zhe yī fèn bào gào
zh: 桌子上放着一份报告。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī fèn bào gào
en: There is a report lying on the table.
why: Place + 放着 + thing needs no 在 before the verb. 在放着 is not used.

s: 走廊里坐着很多等医生的病人。
s_py: zǒu láng lǐ zuò zhe hěn duō děng yī shēng de bìng rén
zh: 走廊里坐着很多等医生的病人。
py: zǒu láng lǐ zuò zhe hěn duō děng yī shēng de bìng rén
en: Many patients waiting for the doctor are sitting in the corridor.
why: This is the existential pattern: place, then 坐着, then the people, with a long modifier before the noun.

s: 你等了，我马上回来。
s_py: nǐ děng le wǒ mǎ shàng huí lái
zh: 你等着，我马上回来。
py: nǐ děng zhe wǒ mǎ shàng huí lái
en: Wait, I'll be right back.
why: An order to keep waiting uses 等着. 了 reports a finished act and cannot make a command.

s: 你先坐着，医生马上就来。
s_py: nǐ xiān zuò zhe yī shēng mǎ shàng jiù lái
zh: 你先坐着，医生马上就来。
py: nǐ xiān zuò zhe yī shēng mǎ shàng jiù lái
en: Stay seated for now, the doctor will be right here.
why: 坐着 is the usual way to tell someone to stay seated.

s: 他不戴着口罩，所以被医生说了。
s_py: tā bù dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ bèi yī shēng shuō le
zh: 他没戴着口罩，所以被医生说了。
py: tā méi dài zhe kǒu zhào suǒ yǐ bèi yī shēng shuō le
en: He wasn't wearing a mask, so the doctor told him off.
why: A 着 state is denied with 没. 不戴着 is not used.

s: 办公室的灯没开着，里面没人。
s_py: bàn gōng shì de dēng méi kāi zhe lǐ miàn méi rén
zh: 办公室的灯没开着，里面没人。
py: bàn gōng shì de dēng méi kāi zhe lǐ miàn méi rén
en: The light in the office isn't on; there's nobody inside.
why: 没 + verb + 着 is the correct way to deny a 着 state.

s: 她带了着孩子去医院。
s_py: tā dài le zhe hái zi qù yī yuàn
zh: 她带着孩子去医院。
py: tā dài zhe hái zi qù yī yuàn
en: She took her child to the hospital.
why: 着 must follow the verb directly, so nothing like 了 can come between 带 and 着.

s: 他知道着你的电话号码。
s_py: tā zhī dào zhe nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ
zh: 他知道你的电话号码。
py: tā zhī dào nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ
en: He knows your phone number.
why: 知道 never takes 着, even though English 'know' feels ongoing.

s: 病人在床上躺着三天了。
s_py: bìng rén zài chuáng shàng tǎng zhe sān tiān le
zh: 病人在床上躺了三天了。
py: bìng rén zài chuáng shàng tǎng le sān tiān le
en: The patient has been lying in bed for three days.
why: A duration after the verb needs 了, never 着.

s: 他睡着了，请你小声一点儿。
s_py: tā shuì zháo le qǐng nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
zh: 他睡着了，请你小声一点儿。
py: tā shuì zháo le qǐng nǐ xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r
en: He has fallen asleep, so please keep your voice down.
why: 睡着 here is shuì zháo, a result complement meaning 'fall asleep', not the particle 着. 了 follows it.

s: 他到着办公室了。
s_py: tā dào zhe bàn gōng shì le
zh: 他到办公室了。
py: tā dào bàn gōng shì le
en: He has arrived at the office.
why: 到 is an instant arrival with nothing to hold, so it never takes 着.
